description: We are SCOUT REGIMENT, a passionate team of aspiring innovators interested in Artificial Intelligence, space exploration, and technology. We aim to transform creative ideas into practical solutions through teamwork, research, and problem-solving. We are particularly interested in using AI to analyze microgravity combustion data and improve fire safety in space. We welcome collaboration with people skilled in Python, AI/ML, and creative problem-solving.
summary:
Project Summary: Flame in Freefall: SI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data

Fire behaves differently in microgravity than on Earth, creating unique safety challenges for astronauts aboard spacecraft and space stations. Flames may spread differently, making fire detection and prevention more difficult.

Flame in Freefall aims to develop an AI-powered system that analyzes NASA's microgravity combustion datasets to understand flame behaviour and identify potential fire hazards. Using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, the system will study combustion patterns, flame characteristics, and changes in fire behaviour under different conditions.

The proposed solution will transform scientific data into meaningful insights through data analysis, visualizations, and predictive models. These insights could help researchers understand fire risks, improve fire prevention strategies, and support the development of safer spacecraft environments.

Our goal is to combine NASA's scientific data with AI technology to make future space missions safer and more reliable.

Team Name: SCOUT REGIMENT
details:
FLAME IN FREEFALL: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data

Flame in Freefall is an AI-powered platform designed to analyze microgravity combustion experiment data and generate meaningful fire safety insights for space exploration.

Problem: Fire behaves differently in microgravity compared to Earth. In space, flames can become spherical, combustion patterns change, and the movement of heat and gases is different. These behaviours create unique fire safety challenges for astronauts and spacecraft.

Our Solution: We propose an intelligent platform that uses Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Computer Vision to analyze combustion images, videos and experimental measurements. It identifies flame characteristics, measures flame size and brightness variations, tracks intensity trends and detects unusual combustion patterns.

Technology Used: Python, React.js, TypeScript, OpenCV, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, FastAPI and data visualization tools.

How It Works: Users can upload combustion experiment data or explore a sample demonstration. The platform processes the data, performs flame analysis, displays interactive visualizations and generates understandable analysis reports.

Uniqueness: Our project combines visual flame analysis, data-driven anomaly detection and an interactive scientific dashboard in one platform.

Expected Benefits: It aims to help researchers interpret microgravity combustion experiments more efficiently, understand unusual flame behaviour and support future spacecraft fire safety research.

Our mission is to transform complex space combustion data into clear, actionable scientific insights.

Team Name: SCOUT REGIMENT
